title: Meri zainab gham se
body:
mere baba jaldi aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
meri zainab gham se mat ghabra
tera baba tere saath mein hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ne waada poora kiya
khanjar ke neeche sajda kiya
maqtal ki jaanib dekh zara
har simt hai khoon shaheedon ka
ab aage hai teri karbobala
tera baba tere saath...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum kam to nahi thay yateemi ke
aur us par zakhm aseeri ke
rukhsaar hai neele bacchi ke
shaano pe nishan hai rassi ke
rakhna bada dhyan sakina ka
tera baba tere saath...
<<DIVIDER>>
aabaad kiya shabbir ne ban
tu aage badhi bandwa ke rasan
bhai hai wahan be-gor o kafan
bechadar hai kufe mein behen
gham dono ka hai milta jhulta
tera baba tere saath...
<<DIVIDER>>
dhaaras hai tu hi yateemon ki
tu hi unki phupi tu hi maa bhi
abbas bhi tu shabbir bhi tu
tu hi fatema zehra tu hi ali
hai baar tere kaandhon pe bada
tera baba tere saath...
<<DIVIDER>>
uff dehshat shaam e ghariban ki
wo sannata wo tareeki
ek haath mein taygh thi tooti hui
ek haath mein kuch jhul si lakdi
mujhe yaad hai wo tera pehra
tera baba tere saath...
<<DIVIDER>>
maana ke bahot dukh paayi hai
shabbir ki tu maajayi hai
quran ke yun kaam aayi hai
sholon se bacha kar laayi hai
abid ke liye ban jaana asa
tera baba tere saath...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri beti tujhsa koi nahi
tu sarwar ke maqsad ki ameen
mat haarna himmat gham se kahin
dhaaye kitne bhi zulm layeen
hai deen ke sar par teri rida
tera baba tere saath...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein bhi hum tere saath rahe
bazaaron mein bhi tere saath chale
darbar mein ab jaana hai tujhe
is waqt bhi hai hum saath tere
mujhe yaad hai apna har waada
tera baba tere saath...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay aamir o nayyar jab jab hum
rakhte hai shaam mein apne qadam
phir jaate hai aankhon mein saare gham
wo jor o jafa wo zulm o sitam
kaano mein yehi aati hai sada
tera baba tere saath...
author: Nayyar Jalalpuri
